title: SequentialSamplingModels.jl: Simulating and Evaluating Cognitive Models of Response Times in Julia
authors: Fernandez, K., Makowski, D., & Fisher, C.
summary: SequentialSamplingModels.jl brings the standard evidence-accumulation models of choice and response time — the drift diffusion model and its relatives — into Julia, with one interface for simulating from them and evaluating their likelihoods.
